svg.title: Share of residents within 15 minutes of a school and a health unit, flat and with elevation, six municipalities of Pernambuco
svg.desc: Dot plots, one row per municipality, of the share of residents within 15 minutes of the nearest public school and primary health care unit, walking and cycling, on a flat network and with the slopes of the Copernicus elevation model. Every municipality loses a few points on foot, Garanhuns the most and Petrolina the least; by bicycle almost nothing changes.
